en.headline: EMSD finds gas leak at internal pipe connection in Prince Edward water heater
en.dek: The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department said a preliminary inspection showed a leak at the hose connection of an approved gas water heater that had passed a check in July 2025.
body: The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department said a gas leak occurred at the internal hose connection of a water heater in a residential unit at Mei Bang Building in Prince Edward on Friday morning, producing a fire and an explosion-like sound.

A female resident was injured on her forehead after being startled and rushing to leave; she was sent to hospital. Five other residents were evacuated. The heater model carried a GU mark and had undergone a safety check in July 2025 that found no abnormalities at the time.
The department has seized the heater for further testing. It said the investigation continues.

zh.headline: 機電署指太子熱水爐內部喉管接駁位漏氣
zh.dek: 署方初步檢驗發現批准型號的煤氣熱水爐內部喉管接駁位置出現氣體洩漏，該爐去年7月檢查時並無異常。
body: 機電工程署表示，周五早上太子美邦大廈一個住宅單位的煤氣熱水爐發生氣體洩漏，導致火警及傳出爆炸聲。
一名女住戶受驚走避時撞傷前額送院，另有五名住戶疏散。涉事熱水爐為署方批准型號並附有GU標誌，2025年7月曾進行安全檢查，當時未發現異常。
署方已檢走熱水爐作進一步檢測，調查仍在進行。
